verified: Anthropic's updated IPO filing lists 825 million shares to be sold at a marketed price range of $70 to $78 per share, according to CNBC and Zacks, both citing the November 10 filing; Techmeme relayed Bloomberg's November 17 report on how that offering is being marketed.
unconfirmed: That Anthropic is telling prospective investors it expects to price at or above the top of that range — Bloomberg attributes this to unnamed people familiar with the matter, and the item gives no final price, no valuation, no pricing date and no independent confirmation that demand actually supports a raise of the range.

verified: Anthropic 正在推进 IPO，营销价格区间为每股 70 至 78 美元，计划发行 8.25 亿股；这一信息来自公司更新后的申报文件，由 CNBC 于 11 月 10 日报道，Zacks 也引述了同一文件。
unconfirmed: 彭博所称 Anthropic 正引导投资者预期定价“在区间上端或更高”，目前仅依据未具名知情人士，Anthropic 未公开确认；最终发行价、对应估值与上市日期均未公布。

titles.en: Anthropic said to guide IPO pricing at or above top of $70–$78 range
titles.zh: Anthropic 据报将 IPO 定价指引至区间顶端或更高
